landingOrigin.detail: Apollo 11 retroreflector alignment; heights are relative to the DTM elevation sampled at this point.

sources.detail: LROC NAC DTM. The companion photometric orthophoto (NAC_ANAPOLLO11.EOR) is not present in volume LROLRC_2001; committed albedo layers are flat neutral regolith until a pinned orthophoto source is added, and the mission-sun DirectionalLight shades the mesh normals. Per-tile hillshade PNGs are regenerable diagnostics.

sun.detail: Mission-appropriate low sun at touchdown; azimuth approximated west-southwest.

albedoEncoding.detail: Flat neutral regolith (RGB 140). Shading is applied in-engine from tile mesh normals under the mission sun.

tiles.detail: Dense near field around Tranquility Base.

heightEncoding.detail: Counts are centimeters above the tile minimum; add zeroPointMeters for meters above the landing-origin elevation.
heightEncoding.zeroPointMeters: <tile minimum height relative to landing origin>

hillshadeEncoding.detail: Diagnostic lambertian hillshade under the mission sun; not consumed by the app.
